title: The Ledger of Small Mercies
setting_summary: A vertical river-town called Kettle Reach, built in stacked tiers along a cliff where the tide governs every hour: the lower landings flood twice daily, so the whole town lives by a bell that opens and closes gates, docks, and courts. A drowned man's ledger surfaces in the silt, listing debts and favors owed across every tier, and its owner's heirs claim the right to collect — turning neighbor against neighbor. The town's only law is a body of inherited proverbs recited aloud at the Bell Court, and whoever can bend a proverb to their case wins the day.
